Who & Why

MASTHEAD

STATIC//NOISE is made by a rotating collective of writers, designers and noise-makers scattered across five cities and three time zones. Here's what we believe — and who's to blame.

We believe design is an argument.

That the grid exists to be broken.

That noise carries more truth than silence.

And that every reader deserves to feel something loud.

The Collective

The Noise-Makers

Issue 14 · 8 contributors

Rachel Okonkwo

Editor-in-Chief

Founded the zine on a kitchen table in 2019 with one borrowed photocopier and a grudge against templates. Writes about type, runs the print shop, and refuses to use a sans-serif body font.

Jonah Marchetti

Features · Glasgow

A recovering UX designer who left the industry to write about it instead. Author of this issue's cover story. Owns a recording of a dying hard drive he plans to press to vinyl.

Priya Venkat

Art Director

Builds every cover by hand, often misregistered on purpose. Believes a layout isn't finished until something is bleeding off the edge of the page. Based in Bangalore.

Tomás Field

Sound Desk

Field-records room tone, refrigerator hum and the inside of empty theatres. Wrote our recurring "Tape Hiss" column. Will talk your ear off about reverb.

Mei Lin Zhou

Studio Visits · Lagos

Travels to small print studios and writes them down before they disappear. Spent 90 minutes covered in pink Riso dust for this issue and considered it a fair trade.

Devon Hartley

Web · Code

Builds the site you're reading right now, by hand, with no framework, on purpose. Wrote the custom cursor and the easter egg. Yes, there's an easter egg. Type "noise".

Asha Brennan

Copy & Conscience

The last set of eyes on every page. Cuts adjectives for sport. Keeps a running list of words we are no longer allowed to use ("seamless" is at the top).

You?

Open Slot · Issue 15

We commission new contributors every issue and we pay real money for real work. Pitch us something loud, weird and specific. Words, art, sound — we read everything.

Pitch
Us.

Issue 15 tunes into "Heat." We want essays, visual experiments, field recordings, type specimens — anything that runs hot. No portfolios, no fluff, no AI slop. Email pitch@staticnoise.zine with one paragraph and one idea.

What We Pay / Promise

  1. £250–£600 per commissioned piece, paid on acceptance, not on publication.
  2. You keep all rights. We license, we never buy outright.
  3. A real human editor reads every pitch within two weeks.
  4. Two contributor copies, hand-printed, mailed anywhere.
